tools.name: latest_models
tools.description: List the newest AI models with sourced facts (release date, context window, modalities, licence, price, source URL, last-verified date). Newest first.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get one model by slug (e.g. gemini-4-argon) or by exact name, with a per-fact source URL, as-of date and Reported/Tested label.

tools.name: latest_releases
tools.description: Latest AI tool release news briefs from Agentic Weekly, with first-seen and source-published timestamps in UTC.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare two items side by side from our data. Each of a and b is a tool slug (see /tools.json) or a model slug (see /models.json).
